title: Reservoir Status light in NSClient
symptom: Reservoir status light is always red on NSClient follower (Xiaomi mi9) regardless of actual units remaining. It stays red even if 'status lights' are turned off in NSClient preferences. The light is not red on main AAPS phone or in NS site.
evidence_quote: Reservoir status light is always red on NSClient follower (Xiaomi mi9). Regardless of actual units remaining.
